commit.message:
Add jrwnnnn-me-commits.json to git add

Update the GitHub Actions workflow to stage the generated jrwnnnn-me-commits.json file before committing and pushing. Also fix the step indentation.

Add step to fetch jrwnnnn/jrwnnnn-me commits [skip deploy]

Insert a workflow step to retrieve commits from the jrwnnnn/jrwnnnn-me repository and write them to jrwnnnn-me-commits.json.

Responsive layout tweaks

The anchor now uses flex-col on small screens and md:flex-row on medium+, and the image container switches to full width on mobile (md:w-30 on larger screens). No functional behavior changes.

Fetch Last.fm scrobbles using env and UA header

Support process.env.LASTFM_API_KEY (with fallback to import.meta.env) and add a User-Agent header to the Last.fm fetch.

Add error handling for Last.fm fetch

Wrap the Last.fm API request in a try/catch and declare lastfm separately, so network or parse errors are caught and logged instead of throwing.

Use native img and remove Astro image config

Remove Astro image handling and simplify the scrobble component.

Revert "Add Last.fm fetch error handling and UI states"

This reverts commit e9ab4af468b6a96876ea320a6e1538d6a5c7fa4e.
Add Last.fm fetch error handling and UI states

Add LastFM scrobble component

Add a new Scrobble.astro component that fetches recent tracks from Last.fm and displays now-playing and recent tracks.
Add CommitLog component
Increase Container padding
Remove unintended space between the prefix and the hash
Add TODO notes; soften stack canvas border
Add lazy loading to tech stack icons Add loading="lazy" to several tech icon elements to improve initial page performance by deferring offscreen image loading.
Prettier refactor [skip deploy]
Preserve 'files' in fetched commit data [skip deploy]
Add tech icons below the radar
Add Prettier config and plugins
Update workflow commit message
Update basic_chron.yml to fetch recent commits [skip deploy]

Update copyright years to 2026 [skip deploy]

Bump copyright years to 2026 in project metadata. Updated LICENSE (2024 -> 2026) and README (2025 -> 2026) to keep copyright/attribution current.
Update README.md [skip deploy]

[skip deploy] Add VS Code settings and extension recommendations

Remove .vscode/ from .gitignore and add workspace configuration: .vscode/extensions.json recommends Prettier, Astro, Tailwind CSS and Markdown All-in-One; .vscode/settings.json enables formatOnSave and sets Prettier as the default formatter for [astro] files.

Rename and rewrite GitHub Actions workflow for Astro

Rename workflow file to deploy_main.yml and replace Node.js Azure deploy pipeline with an Astro-focused build/deploy flow. Changes include: add workflow name "Astro: Build and deploy", skip-deploy condition when commit message contains [skip deploy], enable npm caching in setup-node, switch to npm ci, run npm run astro:build, prune devDependencies before packaging, and add a startup-command (node ./dist/server/entry.mjs) for the Azure Web App.

Namespace npm scripts under astro

Rename npm scripts 'dev', 'build', and 'preview' to 'astro:dev', 'astro:build', and 'astro:preview', and reorder entries to place 'astro' first. This namespaces Astro CLI commands to avoid name collisions and improve clarity when running scripts.
Add or update the Azure App Service build and deployment workflow config

Remove Azure deploy GitHub Actions workflow

Delete the .github/workflows/deploy.yml workflow which built and deployed the Astro app to Azure Web Apps. This removes the Node.js setup, build, artifact upload, and Azure login/deploy steps that ran on pushes to the 'astro' branch.
Update index.astro
Skip deploy job when commit includes [skip deploy]
Fixed broken dynamic scaling on ASCII arts
